title: Piramidal (YC W24) – Software Engineers – NYC Onsite
originalTitle: Piramidal (YC W24) – Software Engineers – NYC Onsite
content:
We're looking for senior software engineers - frontend, backend, and infra - who are excited about solving difficult problems at the boundary of Foundational AI and Neuroscience. Our core backend and infra stack is Python, Go, and Terraform deployed to various cloud and on-prem, while our frontend stack is React and TypeScript. Bonus points for either: standing up and maintaining reliable streaming systems with a production/ops mindset; or building smooth, data-intensive React UIs with modern plotting/visualization libraries. You would take an active role in architecture and design, implementation, and hiring from your early days, and will have the opportunity to have ownership commensurate to your capacity and interests.

Apply here: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/piramidalinc
